Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1615383. Join molecule_dictionary to activities to assays to target_dictionary, then join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1615383, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
